title: K-th Largest Element (Min-Heap of Size k)
summary: Find the k-th largest value in an array while keeping only the k largest seen so far in a min-heap. The root is the smallest of them, so a new value is worth keeping only if it beats the root; at the end the root is the answer.

inputs.name: k
inputs.label: k
inputs.note: Which largest value to find, from 1 (the maximum) up to the array length.
